name: excavator-lift
$comment: Load-sensing hydraulics holding a 1.5 t payload: the boom rings at its hydraulic natural frequency after a pressure sag, then lifts at half joystick with the pump holding its LS margin.

parameters.name: m_boom
parameters.description: Boom mass (with its share of the cylinders)

parameters.name: J_boom
parameters.description: Boom inertia about its centre of mass

parameters.name: m_arm
parameters.description: Arm (stick) mass

parameters.name: J_arm
parameters.description: Arm inertia about its centre of mass

parameters.name: m_bkt
parameters.description: Bucket mass (with its linkage)

parameters.name: J_bkt
parameters.description: Bucket inertia about its centre of mass

parameters.name: m_pay
parameters.description: Payload rigidly carried in the bucket (lift model)

parameters.name: m_bucket
parameters.description: Bucket plus payload

parameters.name: cx_bucket
parameters.description: Centre of mass x in the bucket frame

parameters.name: cy_bucket
parameters.description: Centre of mass y in the bucket frame

parameters.name: J_bucket
parameters.description: Bucket plus payload inertia about their common centre of mass

parameters.name: k_pin
parameters.description: Pin (pivot) translational stiffness

parameters.name: b_pin
parameters.description: Pin translational damping

parameters.name: k_stop
parameters.description: End-stop stiffness at the joints (the cylinder end stops)

parameters.name: b_stop
parameters.description: End-stop damping

parameters.name: beta
parameters.description: Effective bulk modulus of the oil (with hoses)

parameters.name: w_engine
parameters.description: Engine speed (1800 rpm, constant)

parameters.name: dp_ls
parameters.description: LS margin of the pump regulator

parameters.name: P_max
parameters.description: Pump power limit (torque limiter at the engine speed)

parameters.name: p_relief
parameters.description: Main relief valve setting

parameters.name: dp_c
parameters.description: Compensator setting of the valve sections

parameters.name: tau_spool
parameters.description: Spool (pilot) time constant

parameters.name: A_ls
parameters.description: LS edge of each spool

parameters.name: u_lift
parameters.description: Boom joystick during the lift (1 = full)

plots.title: Boom: rod extension [m] and joint angle [rad]
Pump line, LS line and LS margin [Pa]
Power [W]: engine shaft, pump hydraulic, cylinders
Energy [J] and ratio cylinder work / engine energy
